title: Learning optimal gaits and styles for terrain-adaptive quadruped locomotion
title_zh: 学习地形自适应四足运动的优化步态与风格
abstract: Animals use many different gaits to locomote at different speeds across varying terrains. A longstanding question in biology and robotics is: which gait is best? This question is most often addressed from an energy-efficiency perspective on flat terrain, leaving open how the answer depends on terrain and on the criterion optimized. Here we show that gait optimality is determined jointly by terrain, performance metric, and velocity. We use deep reinforcement learning and networks of abstract oscillators, modeling spinal central pattern generators, to learn 11 quadrupedal gaits across diverse challenging terrains, together with the locomotion style (base height, foot ground clearance, foot offsets) that each requires. A second policy then selects among them to optimize a user-specified criterion such as cost of transport, base stability, or joint smoothness. Across these performance metrics and within this repertoire, every gait is optimal under at least one terrain-metric-velocity combination. The framework adapts zero-shot to gait couplings and styles never seen during training, to terrains far beyond the training distribution, and to larger quadrupeds five times the training mass. With a single additional pitch-tracking reward term, the same gait couplings also support bipedal-mode locomotion. Our method provides a general and systematic way to produce expressive locomotion and to select the gait best suited to a given terrain and criterion. Project page: https://guillaume10.github.io/terrain-gaits.
abstract_zh: 动物使用多种步态在不同地形上以不同速度运动。生物学和机器人学中长期存在的问题是：哪种步态最佳？这个问题通常从平坦地形上的能量效率角度来探讨，但答案如何取决于地形和优化标准仍不清楚。本研究表明，步态最优性由地形、性能指标和速度共同决定。我们使用深度强化学习和模拟脊髓中枢模式发生器的抽象振荡器网络，在多种具有挑战性的地形上学习11种四足步态，以及每种步态所需的运动风格（基础高度、足部离地间隙、足部偏移）。然后，第二个策略在这些步态中进行选择，以优化用户指定的标准，如运输成本、基础稳定性或关节平滑度。在这些性能指标下，并且在这个步态库内，每种步态至少在一种地形-指标-速度组合下是最优的。该框架能够零样本适应训练中从未见过的步态耦合和风格、远超训练分布的地形，以及训练质量五倍大的四足动物。通过添加一个额外的俯仰跟踪奖励项，相同的步态耦合也支持双足模式运动。我们的方法提供了一种通用且系统的方法来产生富有表现力的运动，并选择最适合给定地形和标准的步态。项目页面：https://guillaume10.github.io/terrain-gaits。
tldr_zh: 步态最优性由地形、指标和速度共同决定，每种步态都有其适用场景。
cover_zh: 哪种步态最好？答案可能和你想的不一样｜新框架让四足机器人零样本适应新地形
